items.title: 2.3 Electronic configuration ke tajurbati saboot (experimental evidence) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.3, printed page 25.

blocks.text: Electronic banawat (structure) ka jadeed nazariya atom ke Bohr model se nikla hai. Is aur atom ke baad ke models ke saboot (evidence) bunyadi taur par do zariyon se aate hain: atomic spectra aur ionization energies. Agle do topics har ek ko bari bari lete hain.

blocks.prompt: Electrons ki tarteeb ke model ki hemayat ke liye do alag qism ke tajurbe kyun zaroori hain?
blocks.explanation: Atomic spectra dikhate hain ke electrons muqarrar energy levels mein rehte hain, kyunke sirf kuch wavelengths kharij ya jazb hoti hain. Ionization energies naapti hain ke har electron kitni mazbooti se pakra hua hai aur yun shells zahir karti hain. Har ek doosre ki tasdeeq karta hai, jo kisi ek se zyada mazboot saboot hai.

items: Electronic structure ka nazariya Bohr model se barhta hai; us ke saboot atomic spectra aur ionization energies se aate hain.
